DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Subject: pipe bend issue near Fort McMurray
Compliance,
Walking the right-of-way east of pump station 7 this afternoon-checked the 16-inch main around
14:30. Saw a 45° bend (tag B-12) sitting about 60 cm higher than spec, soil washed out
underneath. Pipe isn't leaking, pressures look normal.
While taking photos, Dave slipped on ice and jammed his left ring finger pretty bad-sent him to
the Fort McMurray clinic.
Need someone to look at the bend support and ditch stability.
Jesse
Field Op, Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd.
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
